title: Some people start strong.
paragraphs:
Some people start strong.
But who finishes strong?
Paul wrote these words near the end of his life:
“I have fought the good fight. I have finished the race. I have kept the faith.”

Faith isn’t proven at the start.
It’s proven at the finish line.
Are you running to finish — or just to start?

Starting is exciting.
Finishing is rare.

Faith that lasts through pressure…
through waiting…
through hardship…
That’s the race Paul was talking about.

Paul didn’t say life was easy.
He said he finished the race.
“Starting is easy. Finishing is rare. Who needed this reminder today?”
